variable.name: related_dates
variable.when: 1. In each reply, collect every time mentioned, then set this variable. 2. If no time is mentioned, estimate the current time.
variable.desc: 1. Include the current time, times recalled from earlier turns, and times that appear in books or media. 2. Set the whole array at once, e.g. [{year:1,month:1,day:1},{year:1,month:2,day:3}].
variable.schema: { year: number, month: number, day: number }[]
